sections.text: Near to Toynbee Hall, many people live in flats with limited access to safe, outdoor space.
Our ongoing consultation with local families revealed that because of this, there is a lack of play opportunities and little support for young parents.

Our play programme provides opportunities for children to play outdoors and indoors, whilst also supporting their parents. We make connections to nature for children living in a highly urban environment, supporting their development. Our programme also helps parents to learn about play.
